changesets.name: effect-react-loaded-navigation.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/effect-react": patch
---

### Fixed

- Wait for an active query loader before a newly mounted `useLoaderQuery` screen renders, so links to cached routes after invalidation show the changed data on their first render. Already mounted screens keep their data during refreshes.

changesets.name: quality-extend-tool-paths.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/quality": minor
---

### Breaking

- `toolOwned` in `files/named-after-export` and `files/other-names` now extends the default tool-owned paths instead of replacing them. Remove copied defaults from your configured lists and keep only repository-specific additions.

changesets.name: test-story-screen-roles.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/test-story": minor
---

### Added

- `screenDriver` actions and text/value readouts accept `ScreenTarget` selectors or `{ role, name }` targets, with exact string or regular-expression accessible names, hidden-element exclusion, candidate diagnostics and role/name narration.
- `screenDriver.accessible(element)` computes an existing element's accessible name and role without narration; `accessible(selector)` keeps its narrated readout.

changesets.name: work-board-links-and-columns.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/work-board": patch
---

### Fixed

- Sidebar destinations, the Now / All work / Table switch and answer card links are announced as links instead of buttons, and the All work board shows one column per status name, so items spelled `needs-you` and `needs-human` share one Needs you column.

changesets.name: work-board-search-groups.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/work-board": patch
---

### Fixed

- Search lists each item once: a document's title and the passages under it now share the document's row instead of adding a second row for the title anchor.
- Search rows no longer repeat their title as the snippet; they show the next matching passage instead, or no snippet.

### Changed

- The search palette groups rows under **Go to**, **Appearance**, **Work** and **Documents** headings and drops the "command" subtitle from command rows.
- **Include Fleet records** in the palette sets the new optional `records` search option; the `records:` query prefix keeps working.
- The palette closes through the dialog's standard close control. The Search button is gone: Enter in the field still searches an unfinished query at once, and a failed search offers **Retry search**.

changesets.name: work-fleet-predicted-conflict-hold.md
changesets.text:
---
"@shivaedev/work-fleet": minor
---

### Added

- Predict conflicts against main and watched open PR heads with Git merge-tree, and hold the later PR before review and merge readiness until the earlier PR merges. Continue its worker once to merge main, even after area reservations expire.
- Expose `MergePrediction` and `PredictedConflict` schemas, optional `FleetIntegrations.predict(pr, watchedPrs)` and `MainSource.mergeConflicts(head, otherHeads)` ports, and durable `mergePrediction` and `predictedConflictHold` record fields. Store conflict file names in typed PostgreSQL rows with UTC observation times through an additive migration.

- Acknowledge accepted daemon release commands within the client timeout while launches are busy, then apply their durable responses in the background.
